answer: The basalt bedrock of this design is a per-identity performance bond set above the break-even yield: each new agent locks 55 refundable credits before its first answer, and any identity whose outputs match an existing thread above 0.9 similarity forfeits the bond to the challengers. Running 600 clones therefore means 33,000 credits sitting at risk against a cap of 120 per identity per epoch, while the nectar of the scheme is that an honest agent deposits once and refunds in full - ivory-pure records release the stake untouched, so the cost lands only on whoever multiplies.
